recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed for FHIR-14459 unless a future generated artifact reintroduces a malformed UCUM system URI.
issue_request: FHIR-14459 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 technical correction from OO reporting that the Vital Signs Profile referred to the UCUM coding system as both `http://unitsofmeasure.org` and malformed `http://unitsofmeasure`; the requested correction was to use `http://unitsofmeasure.org`.
initial_application: Git commit d2ba28f2081aa24ada764e47671f577bbe3f0fa4 (`[#14459] fix typo`) applied the typo fix on 2018-02-05 in the old `source/observation/observation-vitalsigns-profile-spreadsheet.xml`, changing the summary text to use `http://unitsofmeasure.org`.
additional_context: The old spreadsheet source has since been refactored away. `source/fhir.ini` still actively includes the Observation resource, and the current Vital Signs sources under `source/observation` use `http://unitsofmeasure.org` for UCUM units. Later Vital Signs binding work such as FHIR-27911 is separate from the missing `.org` URI typo.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because current source is already correct. A scan of `source/observation` found no `http://unitsofmeasure` reference lacking `.org`.

related_jiras.note: A later Patient Care minutes page mentioned FHIR-27911 in relation to Vital Signs UCUM value set/binding behavior, but that is a separate conformance/value-set issue and not part of the FHIR-14459 URI typo.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive STU3 technical correction reporting malformed UCUM coding system references in the Vital Signs Profile.
evidence_items.learned: This establishes that the reconciliation target is correcting `http://unitsofmeasure` to `http://unitsofmeasure.org` in Vital Signs Profile content.

evidence_items.summary: Commit `[#14459] fix typo` updated the old Vital Signs profile spreadsheet from `http://unitsofmeasure` to `http://unitsofmeasure.org`.
evidence_items.learned: FHIR-14459 was explicitly applied in source history before later profile-source refactoring.

evidence_items.summary: `source/fhir.ini` actively includes Observation, and the current Vital Signs units value set composes from `http://unitsofmeasure.org`.
evidence_items.learned: The current relevant source is build-scoped and uses the correct UCUM system URI.

evidence_items.summary: The current Vital Signs profile points its component unit binding at `http://unitsofmeasure.org/vs` and does not spell the malformed system URI.
evidence_items.learned: The current profile representation does not preserve the old STU3 typo.

evidence_items.summary: No malformed `http://unitsofmeasure` references were found in the Observation source tree.
evidence_items.learned: There is no current core source edit needed for FHIR-14459.
